description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Audit all prerequisite acceptance criteria across ZAQ, jido_chat and jido_chat_whatsapp. Update mix.exs/mix.lock to compatible reproducible revisions when authorized/published, retaining upstream ordering core -> package -> ZAQ. During local validation any path overrides stay uncommitted and cannot masquerade as final reproducible dependency state. Record exact SHAs and publication blockers. Reconcile guides/authentication.md, adapter docs, docs/services/channels.md and docs/services/system-config.md with implementation at their owners. Verify no duplicate docs/protocol implementation remains. Do not close old feature approval/E2E issues as part of this refactor.

Tests to add before implementation:
Design cross-package acceptance cases before integrating: fake non-WhatsApp full shared path, legacy Telegram/Mattermost conformance, WhatsApp pairing->save->start->cold restore->send->logout, real sink reentrancy, profile/binding isolation, lifecycle fencing, commit uncertainty and history/mention rules. Reuse tests from prerequisite tasks; fill only evidenced gaps, with applicable approval rules. Existing feature E2E execution only if required by workflow; no new E2E authoring or live WhatsApp traffic. Pure boundary refactor has no new UX journey.

Branches/paths validated:
All epic acceptance criteria including optional-callback defaults, public/private ingress distinction, RAM policy, late callbacks, actor revocation, readiness failures and saved runtime_pending. Audit generic source for concrete WhatsApp modules and conditionals with justified allowed provider-registry/normalizer exceptions. Check new API types/results and samples match actual behavior.

Mocking plan:
Keep internal Jido/ZAQ operations real; external transport and host boundary test doubles only. Record isolation constraints instead of introducing global mock settings or modifying scenario intent.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Owner docs/module docs plus Beadwork validation notes and release handoff. No new standalone execution-plan files. Update any relevant API examples that described extra MFAs.

Action reuse assessment:
Verification/docs portion NOT APPLICABLE to new executable operations; audit that prior REUSE/EXTEND decisions still hold, no duplicate Actions/persistence paths and no tool exposure. Pinning changes composition only, not operation ownership.

Completion gate:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle and each sibling AGENTS.md. Required issue checks precede review; dedicated coverage-upper handoff follows implementation/PR review approval; final ZAQ precommit precedes final human approval. Record commands/results and exact revisions, do not claim previous PR runs validated new code. No commits/push/publication/merge without explicit authorization. If publication or final validation is blocked, preserve issue open with precise blocker; do not mark complete based on local overrides.

Required policy and epic constraints:
Read this epic before starting. Read each affected repository's AGENTS.md. In ZAQ read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/system-config.md and applicable docs/conventions.md; before documentation edits read docs/documentation.md. Run bw prime and verify live source/Git/dependency state. Use Serena for source relationships and Context Mode for large output. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md#phase-4--validate and its final validation/coverage lifecycle rather than treating this ticket as an alternative policy. No existing test behavior change is approved by this plan. No new feature E2E is planned: this is a behavior-preserving boundary refactor with no UI change. Reassess that decision if scope expands.
